definitions.explanation: The anticipated outcome or future possibility.
The likelihood that something will happen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見込|みこ}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧。
examples.english: The outlook for this year is bright.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧20%⟦{増|ぞう}→増：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見込|みこ}み⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Sales are expected to increase by 20% from last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見込|みこ}み⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The construction is expected to be completed next month and is proceeding on schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見込|みこ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見込|みこ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見込|みこ}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦みる→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: The chances of success are low, but I think it's worth trying.

notes:
Noun form of ⟦{見込|みこ}む→見込む：08315_mikomu⟧ (to anticipate, to expect). Used for both future projections and assessments of possibility.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {見込|みこ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is hope/a chance
- {見込|みこ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no hope
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見込|みこ}み: expected to ~
- {見込|みこ}み⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧: as expected

COMPOUNDS:
- {見込|みこ}み⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧: prospective customer
- {見込|みこ}み⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧: miscalculation, misjudgment
- {見込|みこ}み⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧: estimated amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧: outlook, forecast (longer-term perspective)
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧: prediction, forecast (more analytical)
- ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧: expectation, hope (more emotional)
